title: Customer Operations & Writing Specialist
description:
Here at Clerky, we build software to make legal paperwork easier for startups and their attorneys. We're profitable and growing sustainably. We're the most popular way for high-growth technology startups to form, and are also used by many top-tier startups for hiring and fundraising.

 

As a Customer Operations & Writing Specialist at Clerky, you will be the voice of the company to thousands of startup founders, investors, and attorneys. These customers use Clerky to get critical legal paperwork done, often on a tight timeline. Our success is based on word-of-mouth, so we have a strong culture of providing world-class service (ask us about our satisfaction ratings!). We are rabidly customer-centric.

 

What Makes Customer Operations Different at Clerky

 

It’s a lot harder here. Helping our customers can be unusually challenging due to the nuanced and specialized nature of their questions. Doing the job well can require a lot of iterative feedback, so we're looking for someone who thinks critically about their writing and is always looking for ways to improve. Along the way, you'll also pick up a lot of knowledge about startups and startup law.

 

The challenges never stop. The level of learning and craftsmanship that goes into writing responses to our customers requires intense focus. If you’re looking for the kind of position where you can easily master all the information at the beginning and work in a way that does not require intense focus, this position will probably not be a good fit for you. On the other hand, if you love learning and constantly challenging yourself, this position could be a good fit for you.

 

There are often no right answers. We’re often not able to provide definitive answers to the questions we receive. In many cases, the best we can do is to equip our customers with the information they need to be able to figure out the right answer on their own, or to understand that it isn’t possible to figure out what the right answer is. If you prefer an environment more oriented around providing definitive answers, this position may not be a good fit for you.

Minimum Requirements

  • Genuine love for helping people

  • High emotional intelligence

  • Logical / analytical thinker

  • Exceptional written English communication skills, including the ability to write precisely and succinctly

  • Extremely detail-oriented

  • Comfort with working remotely and independently

  • Technologically savvy - you should be confident in your ability to use new software without training

  • Appreciation for giving and receiving feedback often (often several times a day)

  • Natural internal motivation to constantly strive for excellence in everything you do

How We Work

  • Clerky has been remote-first for many years, long before COVID. We’re very familiar with working remotely, and enjoy it.

  • Our team is small, so everyone's contributions matter. We work efficiently, autonomously, and with great respect for each other.

  • We work openly and collaboratively. We’re here to support you in being successful in this role. You'll work closely with other team members to ensure our customers are getting the best possible support and experience.

  • Everyone on our team works hard, and we trust team members to know what will help them be most productive. Schedules are flexible as long as there is adequate team coverage.

  • We want to help you grow, so we have a budget for books, courses, tools, or whatever other educational resources you need to be successful.

  • We offer top-of-market compensation and benefits and the opportunity to learn a lot while helping our customers through an exciting time in their lives.

Responsibilities

  • Writing thoughtful and empathetic replies to customer emails using our help desk software, Help Scout

  • Writing and maintaining help center articles, and identifying topics for new articles based on customer inquiries

  • Working with our engineering team to debug software issues our customers encounter

  • Using our software to develop and manage new ways for our customers to complete legal paperwork

  • Assisting product team by testing new features and bug fixes, and conveying customer feedback

  • Spotting trends in customer issues that other team members should be alerted to

This is a 100% remote position. You'll be able to work from home (or from anywhere else). We offer top-of-market compensation and benefits, reasonable hours, and reasonable customers. No legal experience or background is necessary or preferred.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Communications Manager
description:
About Lemon.io
Lemon.io is building the autopilot for hiring. 
We've replaced the slow, expensive recruiting agency with a platform that delivers vetted, responsive candidates, ready for a final interview. In days, not weeks. 
Hundreds of fast-growing companies use Lemon to build their engineering teams, from early-stage startups to enterprises. We're profitable, bootstrapped, and growing at a moment when the legacy recruiting industry is being rewritten in real time.

Here's why this role exists. We have a great story and almost no one telling it. A profitable company helping rewrite a huge industry with AI, and a voice that is still a blank canvas. You'd be the one who decides how Lemon sounds and makes the market pay attention, working directly with the founder, with the freedom that comes from being bootstrapped.

About the position
The Communications Manager will own Lemon's external voice and its distribution.
The goal: make Lemon impossible to ignore in the engineering-hiring conversation. Every day, something from Lemon should be visible where our buyers and candidates already are, until the market treats us as the category leader.
This is a senior IC role, reporting directly to the founder. You'll personally do most of the writing and build systems for distribution.
This is an intensive role. You'll be producing daily and running a content distribution engine that doesn't stop. And while we'd typically expect 4+ years of experience, we're genuinely open to less experienced candidates who can demonstrate exceptional writing and judgment.

Responsibilities:
1. Executive Communications
- Lead the creation and execution of founders' personal brand platforms
- Produce and distribute day-to-day content across founders' channels
- Support founders' earned media: podcasts, panels, op-eds, and speaking opportunities
2. Internal News Scouting and Narrative Development
- Sit in product, customer success, sales, and ops syncs to identify newsworthy stories
- Identify and shape company moments worth telling publicly
- Translate internal milestones, launches, learnings, and customer wins into external content
- Distribute content via social and traditional media.
3. Team Engagement
- Build and support an internal content program that engages employees across functions
- Equip team members to share their work publicly through ready-to-use content and templates
- Coordinate the team's participation in industry conversations across channels
4. Monitoring, Automation
- Build and maintain content and distribution workflows using AI tools
- Set up monitoring for brand mentions, press coverage, and audience growth across channels
- Track, grow and report on key communications metrics quarterly

What we're looking for:
- Native or fluent English with cultural fluency for the US tech audience
- A genuinely strong writer. 
- You've been the voice behind someone else's posts. 
- Track record telling the story of a company, a product, or a movement
- Background in technology, B2B software, talent, recruiting, dev tools, or adjacent industries.
- You’re deeply immersed in the world of independent media: Substackers, podcasters, influencers on X or LinkedIn. 
- AI is already part of how you work.
- Comfortable operating in areas of genuine uncertainty.
- Results-oriented, with a bias toward action and impact.
- Want to be part of a small, fast-paced, and impactful team.

What success looks like in the first 4 weeks:
- You've built systems to capture content from our team and product, and to manufacture news.
- You've launched an amplification program by the team and outside voices, so every message travels.
- A repurposing workflow exists: one idea becomes a post, a thread, a clip, a newsletter line, without starting over each time.
- You've identified the 3 to 5 narratives that everyone will repeat.
- You've identified a few internal voices and enabled them to post regularly, with systems that feed them content ideas.
- By week 4, the founder's social posts go out 4 to 5 times a week.
- Baseline metrics captured, so growth is measurable from a known starting point.
Application Process

To apply, send us:
- Three writing samples that show range. At least one should be in a voice that isn't yours: something you ghost-wrote for an executive, a founder, or another public-facing operator.  
- A short note (200 words or fewer) telling us why this role and what you'd want to ship in your first 90 days. The point isn't to summarize your resume. It's to give us a sense of how you think and what you'd actually do.

What to expect:
- Application review within 7 days
- 45-minute call with the hiring team
- Paid trial project (up to 10 hours)
- Final 60-minute conversation with the founder
- Reference checks and offer

We aim to move from application to offer within 3-4 weeks.

description:

If you’re someone who loves mentorship, thrives in a high-performance environment, and wants to make a real difference in people’s lives, keep reading.

This is a remote, full-time position. You must be available during 8AM–5PM EST, Monday to Friday. On average, you’ll work up to 9 hours per day, and some days will require a little more effort of 10 hours.

You must currently live in North America, Europe, or South Africa, and speak fluent, accent-neutral English. Clear communication is non-negotiable, we’re in the coaching business.

  • Help innovate our products by creating and producing new video trainings/worksheets to deliver a world-class experience.

  • You will be responsible for daily reporting on multiple communication channels (Slack, text message, spreadsheets, etc.,) and so a high attention to detail and compliance with standard operating procedures is essential.
  • You must have a high attention to detail and understand systems/processes so you are able to innovate new, more efficient SOPs (processes) to ensure our Fulfillment Team hits their KPIs

WHO THIS IS FOR:

  • A coach or mentor at heart—you love helping people
  • Clear, professional communicator (spoken and written English)
  • Experienced with organic marketing on Instagram/Facebook/TikTok (creating reels, organic posts, to generate organic leads)
  • Sales background
  • Able to handle fast-paced environments, multiple clients, and changing priorities
  • Willing to grow with us long-term (3+ years)—this isn’t a side hustle
  • Open to feedback and constructive coaching (we’ll train you, but we expect growth)
  • Comfortable with tools like Loom, Calendly, Slack, GSuite, CRMs, etc—or willing to learn fast

WHO THIS IS NOT FOR:

  • You have another full-time job or multiple freelance clients
  • You struggle with structure, deadlines, or fast execution
  • You dislike being challenged to improve daily



Benefits

Expected Earnings (Rev share on book of business): $10,000–$15,000+ USD/month (depending on experience)

Commission opportunities: % on referrals, upgrades, renewals, and pending payment collections.

The Transportation Analyst supports transportation planning, daily shipment execution, customer service, and performance reporting across the transportation network. This role combines analytical problem solving with service-oriented communication to improve shipment visibility, monitor on-time performance, support track-and-trace activity, identify trends and exceptions, and provide timely reporting and follow-up to carriers, internal stakeholders, and operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support transportation planning activities by reviewing shipment demand, routing requirements, carrier capacity, delivery schedules, and operational constraints.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region â this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

title: VP Revenue
description:
Mongoose is the leading AI Engagement Platform in higher education. Colleges and universities use us to increase enrollment, retention, and fundraising — without adding staff.


We have the product and the customers. What we don't have yet is a revenue engine to match. That's this role. As VP of Revenue, you own it end to end — new business, client success, account management, and, most importantly, the system that ties them together. Your job is to make it simple and run it with discipline.



What You'll Do


  • Own all of revenue. The whole revenue org reports to you — one team, one leader. New business, client success, and account management are the front line, with enablement and operations behind them — the training and tools that set them up to win. It all serves one goal: grow ARR — by winning new business and helping our customers succeed. So you're measured on two things: new ARR and gross retention.




  • Build a simple, repeatable selling system. One clear path from first call to close to renewal — the stages, standards, and playbooks the whole team runs the same way. Make it so clear that reps know what good looks like and spend their time selling, not guessing. Done right, it shows up in forecasts you can trust, faster deals, and better conversion at every step.




  • Grow the people who sell it. Our reps are early in their careers and hungry, so growing them isn't a side project — it's the job. You build the system that does it: ramp, enablement, and a steady coaching cadence. And you're in it, not above it — in the deals and the reviews, helping close and coaching the fundamentals in the moment, not from a slide at quarter's end. The result is reps who sell with real confidence and conviction: they know how to win, and they believe they will.




  • Move us up-market. Our next stage of growth is in bigger deals. You know where the real opportunity lives in higher ed, and you focus the team there — raising the ACV we pursue, building around the highest-value accounts, and growing the ones with real upside. It takes sharp market judgment, a head for the numbers, and the discipline to say no to deals that aren't worth the team's time.




  • Run revenue like an AI company. Most revenue orgs still operate the way they did decades ago — we won't. We sell AI for a living, and the whole company is getting far more efficient, accurate, and effective by letting AI do the manual work. That takes more than watching for the next AI tool — it takes imagination: you picture how technology could reinvent the work, then we build it.






What You'll Bring


  • You've run a full revenue org — new business and retention both — and carried a number yourself, not just managed people who carried theirs.




  • When a number gets missed, you go straight to the funnel math — pipeline, conversion, time-in-stage — not the story about why.




  • You've built a selling system that works — whether you stood it up from scratch or overhauled a broken one inside an established org.




  • You're a real coach. You've taken early-career reps and turned them into closers — hands-on, not from a dashboard.




  • You think in unit economics and read a market fast. You've moved a team toward bigger, better deals, and had the discipline to walk from the rest.




  • You're already using AI to reinvent how you work, and you don't wait for permission to push it further.




  • Higher ed or EdTech experience is a strong plus, not a must. The market has real nuance — if you haven't lived in it, show us how you'll close the gap fast.






How We WorkRevenue doesn't run in isolation. You're a key member of our senior leadership team — leading revenue alongside the CEO, partnering with Product and Marketing on go-to-market, and with Finance and People to run the business. Tight feedback loops, honest calls, shared decisions. We hold each other accountable to the plan — and to the whole outcome, not just our own lane.


More About Mongoose

1,000+ higher ed institutions already trust Mongoose — built to give their teams exponentially more capacity across the systems they already run.


AI handles the routine, so people can focus on the work that actually moves students forward — more applications completed, more students retained, more donors reached. Same team. Much bigger impact.



What We Offer

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401K with company match: 100% of the 1st 3% and 50% of the next 2%

  • Flexible PTO

  • Competitive Leave Policies

  • 13 paid holidays, including a week off between Christmas and New Year’s




The BasicsRemote, anywhere in the US. Some travel — for customers, for big deals, and for time together as a team.
 
At Mongoose, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and inclusion builds stronger teams. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know—we’re here to help.

title: CFO Controller
description:
About Company

ADFAC, LLC is a private investment partnership with offices in Honolulu and Los Angeles. The firm is seeking a finance leader to support Hawaiian Cool Water, a Honolulu-based water treatment and equipment leasing company, along with related business interests.

This role offers the opportunity to serve as the primary financial partner to ownership while helping guide the company's financial operations and long-term planning.

The Role

ADFAC is seeking a Part-Time CFO / Controller to oversee the company's financial function, providing strategic financial guidance while remaining hands-on with day-to-day accounting and reporting. The position works closely with ownership to support financial planning, compliance, and operational decision-making.

This long-term remote engagement is designed for an experienced finance executive seeking meaningful impact with a flexible part-time schedule and responsibility for a single business.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management

  • Lead the monthly financial close process and financial reporting.
  • Ensure GAAP compliance across accounting activities.
  • Develop budgets, rolling forecasts, and budget-to-actual analyses.
  • Manage fixed asset accounting and lessor accounting for equipment leasing operations.

Treasury & Financial Planning

  • Oversee banking relationships and cash management.
  • Monitor loan covenant compliance.
  • Partner with the external CPA firm on tax planning initiatives.

Leadership

  • Coach and develop the Accounting Specialist.
  • Serve as the primary financial advisor to ownership.
  • Support strategic financial decision-making and business planning.

Qualifications

  • CPA strongly preferred.
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience.
  • Big Four/Five public accounting experience is a plus.
  • Hands-on controller experience with executive-level financial judgment.
  • Strong understanding of recurring revenue metrics, including MRR, churn, and margin.
  • Availability during Pacific or Hawaii business hours.

Compensation

  • $150â$165 per hour.
  • Long-term 1099 independent contractor engagement.

Time Commitment

  • Approximately 40â50 hours per month (9â12 hours per week).
  • Fully remote.
  • Flexible work schedule.
  • Training and transition support provided by the outgoing CFO/Controller.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
We are seeking a Social Media Strategist to build and grow a personality-led social media presence from the ground up.

This is a hands-on, end-to-end role covering strategy, account setup, content planning, production management, publishing, audience growth, community management, and performance optimization across Instagram and TikTok. You will work closely with the founder to establish a distinctive online identity and develop it into a recognizable, highly engaging social presence.

Responsibilities

  • Build and launch the Instagram and TikTok profiles from zero, including positioning, tone of voice, content pillars, visual direction, and channel strategy
  • Develop and execute the organic growth strategy, with a focus on reach, engagement, follower growth, and long-term audience development
  • Create viral campaign concepts, social-first stories, and repeatable content formats that establish a distinctive and recognizable online personality
  • Manage the full content lifecycle, including research, ideation, scripting, content calendars, production coordination, approvals, publishing, and optimization
  • Use platform analytics, audience insights, watch time, retention, and engagement data to guide creative decisions and improve performance
  • Manage day-to-day community engagement and coordinate with the founder and creative partners


Requirements

  • Proven experience launching and organically growing Instagram and TikTok accounts from an early or zero-follower stage
  • A strong portfolio of high-performing, viral, or culturally relevant social content supported by measurable growth results
  • Deep understanding of Instagram and TikTok algorithms, audience behavior, retention, discoverability, engagement, and organic growth mechanics
  • Strong creative strategy and social-first storytelling skills, with the ability to turn a personality into compelling and repeatable content
  • Hands-on experience managing social media end to end, from strategy and content development through production, publishing, analytics, and community management
  • Strong project management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with the founder and creative production partners
  • Able to work PST hours


Nice to Have

  • Experience working with creator-led brands, founders, entertainment properties, personality-driven accounts, legal brands, or character-led content is advantageous but not required

title: DesiMixTape
description:
AI-powered Indian music discovery

Indian music, made easier to discover and mix.

DesiMixTape explored an AI-powered home for discovering Indian music across genres and eras, creating personal mixes, and sharing playlists with a community.

Explore the product thesis See how it works

Indian music discovery AI-assisted mixes Community playlists

Discover Genres, eras, and artists

Create Personal mixes

Listen Track previews

Share Playlists and community

Built around discovery Explore Indian music across genres, languages, artists, and musical eras.

Designed for making Move from finding tracks to arranging and saving a personal mix.

Community-aware Share playlists and discover what other listeners are putting together.

The product thesis

A cultural discovery layer, not another generic music catalogue.

DesiMixTape began with a simple question: how might discovery feel if Indian musicânot a global catalogue with an India filterâwere the centre of the experience?

The product brought discovery, previews, playlists, mix creation, and sharing into one music journey. Its AI layer was intended to help listeners cross familiar boundaries between genres and eras while keeping people in control of what they assembled and shared.

Discover music

Explore a broad collection of Indian music through artists, genres, moods, and eras.

Create mixes

Collect, order, and save tracks as a personal playlist with AI assistance.

Preview and refine

Listen as you browse and adjust a mix before deciding what belongs.

Share and connect

Publish a mix for friends and discover playlists assembled by other listeners.

Product approach

From discovery to a mix worth sharing.

DesiMixTape brings the core music journey into one focused experience: discover across Indian music, collect tracks, shape a personal mix, and share it with other listeners.

Bring promising tracks into one personal listening space.

Arrange tracks into a mix with AI assistance and listener control.

Publish playlists for friends and the wider listening community.

title: Expertise Path and Manager Path
description:
30+ Engineering Career Ladders

Before jumping into the list, let's quickly discuss software engineering career ladders. We can extract common traits from those career ladders; understanding those characteristics allows us to connect the dots more easily and compare different career ladders efficiently.

What Is a Career Ladder?

A career ladder, or career path, is a progression framework. It allows an organization to describe the different job levels and the expectations for a given position.

It enables the assessment of a software engineer's skills and to work on her career progression. It provides a shared framework to identify the different aspects to improve to reach the next job level.

The ladder can also be mapped with employee's compensation, increasing salaries transparency, and fairness.

Expertise Path and Manager Path (Dual-Track)

Most of the software engineering career ladders are dual tracks ladders.

They have a joint base for the first positions, and at some point, two paths are possible the expertise path and the people management path. The expertise path is often named the individual contributor track, the people management path is often called the manager track.

The career path depends on the stage of the company and the size of the team. New positions will usually appear while the engineering group is growing.

Example for a tiny team (up to 10 engineers)

You'll rarely find ladders at that scale; it's still very early stage, the team is a handful of engineers working with a CTO or a Tech Lead. In startups, the engineering lead is often the technical Co-founder and CTO.

Single Track Notes Engineer Creating solutions to business problems Senior Engineer Handling most complex parts and mentoring Engineering Lead She may handle people management aspects

At this stage, it's pretty common to have one lead developer or engineering lead who owns technical guidance and organizes the team's delivery. She is often more focused on delivery and does not handle people management which a founder still handles.

Example for a small team (~20 engineers)

At that point, the company will introduce middle management positions, usually an Engineering Manager (EM) position. The EM supports a group of 5 to 10 engineers, especially on human resources and project management aspects (ex: hiring, onboarding, organizing, coaching, delivery plan, reporting).

In some companies, EM can be very hands-on on the system part and provide technical and architecture guidance, playing both technical leader and people/team leader. Usually, the company starts to split tech guidance and people management; both require significant and specific expertise.

Individual Contributor (IC) Track People Manager Track Engineer - Senior Engineer - Tech Lead Engineering Manager

Example for a medium team (50+ engineers)

You'll start to have more levels and more expert positions at that stage. The company has usually introduced the role of Head of Engineering, Engineering Director, or VP Engineering. This role is about leading the whole engineering department; the engineering managers will report the person having this role.

Leadership has usually introduced another new role to support the technical guidance at a broader scale, for the whole system or a large part of the system. This role can be named Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, etc.

Individual Contributor (IC) Track People Manager Track Engineer - Senior Engineer - Tech Lead Engineering Manager Staff Engineer VP Engineering

Example for a large team (100 to 1000+ engineers)

At this stage, the engineering department will create a lot of new intermediary positions to capture the level of expertise and area of ownership and impact. Welcome to Senior Engineer I and II, Engineering Director, etc.

Individual Contributor (IC) Track People Manager Track Engineer I - Engineer II - Senior Engineer I - Senior Engineer II - Tech Lead Engineering Manager Senior Tech Lead Senior Engineering Manager Staff Engineer Engineering Director Senior Staff Engineer Senior Engineering Director Principal Engineer VP Engineering Senior Principal Engineer Senior VP Engineering

title: Rent the Runway
description:
Mar 26

Mar 26 Sharing Our Engineering Ladder

Camille

I gave a talk last year at the NYC CTO summit on how and why to introduce structure into an engineering organization (slides available here). I am a fan of structure and the clarity that it can provide an organization, despite its potential downsides. I'm not going to talk about the WHY very much in this post, but I thought it was about time that I helped with the HOW.

Creating an engineering ladder (that is, the job descriptions and levels of an engineering organization) is a daunting task. If you do a half-hearted job, you're likely to cause more problems than you solve. The very first ladder I presented to my team was based on the ladder at Foursquare*. It was very simple, with one or two descriptive elements per "attribute" of engineering (technical skill, communication skill, etc), and by all accounts worked very well for their team. I hoped that this style of providing fewer details would result in people being less obsessed with the ladder, less likely to try to negotiate their level on "technicalities". Boy was I wrong. Almost immediately I had engineers debating me over whether they were at the right level, and there was a great deal of anxiety and confusion throughout the organization. I left room for generous interpretation, and it made it difficult for me to explain what I really wanted and expected.

In addition to the ladder causing problems inside of my team, we were having a hard time evaluating candidates during interviews and determining what level to hire them into. Particularly at the more senior levels, it wasn't clear what the criteria for success really looked like. So, together with my tech leads and engineering managers, we rewrote the ladder to be more specific. It has been very helpful both for the process of reviews and promotion committees as well as for the process of hiring.

I have since shared my ladder privately with several engineering managers around the country who were looking for inspiration, and today we're making it public for the benefit of all. I'm sharing this ladder not to suggest that it is the be-all end-all of engineering ladders, but to give you what I hope is a more thorough starting point than you might have seen elsewhere. After all, no one is really writing these ladders from scratch, whether we pull directly from other companies (as this one does at points), or indirectly from our past experience, so the more data points the merrier.

Without further ado, I present our engineering ladder, in both spreadsheet, and long-winded text, warts and all. Please feel free to clone this ladder and update it for use in your own organizations.

  • A special thanks to Harry Heymann, Jason Liszka and Andrew Hogue, authors of the original Foursquare eng ladder!

Camille

title: Technical Recruiter 2026 New Graduate
description:
About Radiant

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the worldâs first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The companyâs first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiantâs unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

About the Role

Radiant is seeking a driven recent grad to join our talent team and help build the engineering teams behind Kaleidos, our portable, mass-producible nuclear microreactor targeting commercial deployment in 2028. This is a role for someone who wants to start a career in recruitment, work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with real ownership and influence, build a deep tech career, and learn about several technical domains like nuclear, hardware, electrical, software, and more. You'll get close mentorship from recruiters and sourcers who've built teams before, regular visibility with executives, own requisitions, and find top talent for engineering leaders and their teams.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Run your own reqs from open to close, building the pipeline, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and getting offers signed.

  • Find niche talent markets for specialized engineering roles in places like GitHub repos, arXiv papers, technical mailing lists, tech foundation communities, conference speaker rosters, and academic programs.

  • Create talent market reports based on research you drive to help make better-informed recruiting strategies.

  • Coordinate interviews and help facilitate hiring team debriefs to keep decisions moving quickly.

  • Sit in on offer conversations with senior recruiters and learn how strategy and closing work in practice.

  • Help shape how Radiant recruits; the processes, tools, and 3rd party platforms you help build and adopt now become the foundation the team scales on.

  • Get hands-on exposure to hiring across multiple technical functions: electrical, mechanical, software, and more.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.

  • 0â2 years of experience in recruiting, sales, sourcing, or coordination, or you've picked it up on your own and can point to something that proves it.

  • Something outside the classroom that shows real team influence, a club you led, student government, a project you built, a sport you competed in, or work you volunteered for.

  • A genuine pull toward hardware, nuclear, physics, or AI/ML; you don't need an engineering background, just real curiosity.

  • A bias toward action: you move quickly, problem-solve on the fly, and know when to raise your hand for help.

  • You're able to hold a genuine conversation with technical candidates, curious enough to ask good questions, and honest enough to admit when something's outside your depth.

Desired Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM-related major is a plus.

  • Any prior exposure to hardware, software, engineering, or tech recruiting, even informally.

  • Comfort picking up new tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS, sourcing, LLM platforms, even without direct prior experience.

Additional Requirements:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission.

  • Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.

Benefits and Perks

  • Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

  • Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

  • One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

  • Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

  • Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

  • Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

  • 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

  • Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

  • Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

  • Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

  • Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.

Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiantâs new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

The best of todayâs advanced reactor builders donât wait for job postings. They join the winning team. If thatâs you, contact us directly for immediate opportunities: recruiting@radiantnuclear.com.

title: Personalsachbearbeiter / HR Administration (m/w/d)
description:
Über die Bovensiepen Gruppe

Was Burkard Bovensiepen 1965 in Kaufbeuren begründete, ist heute ein international anerkanntes Familienunternehmen mit eigener Handschrift: Die Bovensiepen Gruppe – geführt von seinen Söhnen Andreas und Florian Bovensiepen – steht für automobilen Anspruch, handwerkliche Exzellenz und die Überzeugung, dass jedes Detail zählt. „Born and made in Buchloe“ ist kein Slogan, sondern ein Versprechen: Was hier entsteht, entsteht mit Hingabe, Präzision und dem unbedingten Willen zur Qualität.

Dezember 2025 stehen wir mitten in einer der spannendsten Phasen unserer Unternehmensgeschichte: sechs spezialisierte Sparten, eine eigenständige Marke, rund 200 Mitarbeitende. Die organisatorischen Grundlagen sind gelegt. Jetzt beginnt die eigentliche Aufgabe: eine neue Organisation zum Leben bringen, eine veränderte Führungskultur verankern und die richtigen Menschen für die nächste Phase gewinnen und entwickeln.Dafür suchen wir eine Personalsachbearbeitung, die sorgfältige Sachbearbeitung mit Mitdenken verbindet – und die in einer wachsenden Organisation den nächsten Schritt vorbereiten will.

Aufgaben

Ihre Rolle – drei Säulen der operativen Personalarbeit

Sie arbeiten in drei Säulen der operativen Personalarbeit zu und mit: in der Zeitwirtschaft (Pflege und Administration des Systems, Fehlzeiten, Schnittstellenprüfung zur extern vergebenen Entgeltabrechnung), im Recruiting (Ausschreibungen schalten, Bewerbermanagement, Telefonscreenings koordinieren, Kandidatenkommunikation) und in der operativen Personalarbeit von Verträgen über Zeugnisse bis zum Onboarding. Sie berichten an Janet Weiss (Leitung Personal), stimmen sich eng mit ihr ab und haben dabei Gestaltungsspielraum in Absprache – Entscheidungen und Verantwortung liegen bei der Personalleitung.

Zur Einordnung, damit die Erwartungen von Anfang an stimmen: Dies ist bewusst eine Sachbearbeitungsstelle, noch keine Referentenrolle. Nach der Übergabe der ALPINA-Markenrechte an BMW stellt sich unsere Organisation neu auf – sechs Sparten, wachsende Mannschaft, Prozesse, die mitwachsen müssen. Saubere, verlässliche Personaladministration ist dabei kein Hintergrundrauschen, sondern das Fundament, auf dem alles andere aufsetzt. Noch etwas zur Präsenz: 200 Mitarbeitende brauchen ein Personalteam, das da ist, wenn man es braucht – deshalb arbeiten Sie gerade in der Anfangszeit vor Ort in Buchloe. Nach der Einarbeitung ist Homeoffice perspektivisch nach Absprache möglich. Unsere Arbeitszeit läuft von Montag bis Freitagmittag.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Pflege und Administration der Zeitwirtschaft im Tagesgeschäft
  • Schnittstellenprüfung zur extern vergebenen Entgeltabrechnung: Sie liefern die Daten termingerecht und prüfen die Ergebnisse, bevor sie rausgehen
  • Recruiting im Tagesgeschäft: Stellenausschreibungen schalten, Bewerbermanagement führen, Telefonscreenings koordinieren

  • Vertretung der Teamkolleginnen und -kollegen im Personalteam sowie Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung der HR-Prozesse.

Sachbearbeitung heißt bei uns nicht Abarbeiten nach Schema: Sie denken mit, schlagen vor und gestalten in Absprache mit der Personalleitung – und prägen so mit, wie verlässlich sich Personalarbeit für 200 Menschen anfühlt.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil – genau, schnell, verbindlich

Sie arbeiten gern genau, zügig und verlässlich – und wollen dabei mitdenken statt nur abarbeiten. Sie schätzen klare Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft, übernehmen Aufgaben aber selbstständig, sobald der Rahmen steht. title: Senior Key Account & Retail Development Manager DE & AT (m/w/d)
description:
Team und Verantwortlichkeiten

​​​​Build Partnerships. Create Growth. Make an Impact.

Recovery zählt zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Kategorien im Sportfachhandel. Seit mehr als 20 Jahren gestaltet BLACKROLL® diesen Markt aktiv mit und hat gemeinsam mit führenden Handelspartnern in Deutschland und Österreich eine der stärksten Premium-Marken der Kategorie aufgebaut.
Jetzt suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die mit Leidenschaft bestehendes Geschäft weiterentwickelt, neue kommerzielle Potenziale erschließt und gemeinsam mit unseren Handelspartnern die Zukunft des Handels aktiv mitgestaltet.
Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer pragmatischen Hands-on-Mentalität und verwandelst Ideen in messbaren kommerziellen Erfolg. Du hinterfragst den Status quo, erkennst Wachstumspotenziale und schaffst dort echten Impact, wo andere nur Routine sehen.

Deine Mission
Du übernimmst die kommerzielle Verantwortung für die strategisch wichtigsten Handelspartner von BLACKROLL® in Deutschland und Österreich. Deine Mission ist es, bestehendes Geschäft auszubauen, neue Produktkategorien und Retail-Konzepte erfolgreich im Markt zu etablieren und kommerzielle Chancen zu identifizieren, die langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere Kunden und für BLACKROLL® schaffen.
In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Trade Marketing, B2B Marketing und bereichsübergreifenden Teams verwandelst Du ambitionierte Ideen in exzellente Retail-Umsetzung und nachhaltiges Wachstum.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Strategische Key-Account-Verantwortung
    Du betreust und entwickelst ein Portfolio strategischer Retail-Accounts in Deutschland und Österreich und baust langfristige Partnerschaften sowie nachhaltige Wachstumspläne auf.
  • Umsatz-, Forecast- und kommerzielle Planung
    Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die jährliche Umsatzplanung, Forecasts, Budgetsteuerung und die kommerzielle Performance deines Kundenportfolios.
  • Joint Business Planning & Trade Activation
    Du entwickelst und setzt gemeinsam mit Retail-Partnern jährliche Business-Pläne um, inklusive Promotions, Kampagnen, Produktlaunches und kommerzieller Wachstumsinitiativen.
  • Retail Excellence & POS-Entwicklung
    Gemeinsam mit dem Trade-Marketing-Team treibst du den Rollout, die Optimierung und den Ausbau der Premium-Retail-Konzepte von BLACKROLL voran – inklusive Zweitplatzierungen, gebrandeter Flächen und In-Store-Erlebnissen.
  • Sell-in- & Sell-out-Performance-Management
    Du analysierst und verbesserst die Account-Performance durch datengetriebenes Account Management, Sell-out-Initiativen, Sortimentsoptimierung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Retail-Partnern.
  • Kategorie- & Produktausbau
    Du identifizierst Potenziale, um neue BLACKROLL Produktkategorien und Lösungen erfolgreich in bestehenden und neuen Retail-Kanälen einzuführen und zu skalieren.
  • New Business Development im Retail
    Du gewinnst und entwickelst neue strategische Retail-Partner in priorisierten Segmenten wie Sports Retail, Healthcare Retail und Sleep Retail.
  • Cross-funktionale kommerzielle Führung
    Du agierst als zentrale kommerzielle Schnittstelle zwischen Kund und internen Teams und arbeitest eng mit Trade Marketing, B2B Marketing, Supply Chain und Produktmanagement zusammen, um eine bestmögliche Umsetzung sicherzustellen.


Dein Profil

  • Du bringst 7 - 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Key Account Management, Sales oder Retail Business Development mit - idealerweise in Sports Retail, Consumer Goods, Health & Wellness oder verwandten Branchen.
  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfolge im Management und Ausbau strategischer Retail-Accounts erzielt.
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in Jahresplanung, Forecasting, Budgetsteuerung und kommerziellen Verhandlungen.
  • Du hast erfolgreich Sell-in-, Sell-out- und Retail-Performance-Initiativen umgesetzt.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Trade Marketing und Marketing zusammen, um Retail-Aktivierungen, Kampagnen und Promotions wirkungsvoll umzusetzen.
  • Du hast ein starkes Verständnis für Retail Operations, POS Excellence und eine hochwertige Markenpräsentation.
  • Du überzeugst durch Hands-on-Mentalität, Ownership, Umsetzungsstärke sowie sehr gute Kommunikations-, Stakeholder- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten.
  • Du denkst strategisch, erkennst Wachstumspotenziale und übersetzt sie in kommerzielle Ergebnisse; ein bestehendes Netzwerk im deutschen und österreichischen Retail ist ein klarer Vorteil.


Das erwartet dich bei uns

Wir haben viel Raum für Regeneration und zum Krafttanken geschaffen. Unter anderem 6 Wochen Urlaub, Home-Office Regelung und flexible Arbeitszeiten. Bewusste Phasen der Aktivierung sind bei uns fester Bestandteil in einem Office, indem wir gesundes Arbeiten umsetzen.  Wir lieben unseren Standort, der uns einen wunderbaren Ausblick auf den See und die damit verbundenen Benefits bietet. Unsere Arbeit in Rollen zeichnet sich durch Transparenz, klare Verantwortlichkeiten und selbstverantwortliches Handeln aus. Interner und externer Wissensaustausch wird gefördert und ermöglicht uns eine permanente gemeinsame Entwicklung. Wir haben viel Spass zusammen. Zudem übernehmen wir als Arbeitgeber 70% der Pensionskassenbeiträge und unsere Mitarbeitenden geniessen Produktrabatte intern sowie bei externen Partnern.
Aufgrund der Reisetätigkeit dieser Position unterstützen wir Dich mit einer passenden Mobilitätslösung, beispielsweise in Form eines Firmenwagens oder einer Car Allowance. Über das angegebene Einstiegsgehalt hinaus berücksichtigen wir Deine Erfahrung, Qualifikation und nachweisbaren Erfolge mit einer entsprechend attraktiven Vergütung.

Bereit, Retail Growth aktiv zu gestalten?
Wenn Du strategische Handelspartner nicht nur betreuen, sondern aktiv entwickeln willst – und Lust hast, BLACKROLL® im Retail sichtbar, relevant und kommerziell erfolgreich weiter auszubauen - freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

Ein klassisches Motivationsschreiben brauchst Du nicht.
Spannender für uns sind Deine Erfahrungen, Deine Herangehensweise und Dein Impact.
Bitte beantworte uns kurz folgende Fragen:

  • Wie hast Du in der Vergangenheit strategische Retail Accounts nachhaltig entwickelt und Wachstum erzielt?
  • Beschreibe ein Beispiel, bei dem Du Sell-in, Sell-out oder POS-Performance messbar verbessert hast. Welche Hebel hast Du genutzt?
  • Welche Chancen siehst Du für BLACKROLL® im deutschen und österreichischen Retail - und wie würdest Du diese angehen?


Dein Ansprechpartner

Hast du Fragen?
Ich bin dein Ansprechpartner aus dem People & Culture Team. Ich freue mich, wenn du dich für unser Unternehmen interessierst und beantworte gerne alle deine Fragen rund ums Thema arbeiten bei BLACKROLL®.

title: Team Lead - Site Reliability Engineering (all genders)
description:
Introduction

FACT-Finder entwickelt Product-Discovery-Technologie für den eCommerce und ist mit den Produkten Next Generation und Infinity bei führenden Online-Shops in Europa im Einsatz. Aktuell modernisieren wir unser Hosting konsequent in Richtung Kubernetes auf Harvester – als on-prem Hybrid mit der Option, mittelfristig vollständig in die Cloud zu skalieren. Als Team Lead Site Reliability Engineering (all genders) verantwortest du Reliability, Skalierbarkeit und Kosten unserer Hosting-Umgebungen, treibst diese Transformation end-to-end voran und führst das Team, das sie umsetzt.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die operative Gesundheit unseres Hostings über On-Premise (Frankfurt, Stockholm) und Cloud hinweg – Verfügbarkeit, Performance, Incident Management.
  • Du treibst die Modernisierung in Richtung Kubernetes auf Harvester aktiv voran: Cluster-Topologie, Storage (Longhorn), Networking (VLAN, Load Balancing, Ingress), Backup und Disaster Recovery.
  • Du baust eine produktionsreife k8s-Plattform auf: Lifecycle, Upgrades, RBAC, Secrets, GitOps (Argo CD / Flux), Observability und Policy-Guardrails.
  • Du gestaltest den NG Search Operator (Custom Kubernetes Operator) und löst Auto-Scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, Cluster Autoscaler) für die aktuelle Architektur.
  • Du definierst unser On-Prem-Hybrid-Modell konkret: welche Workloads laufen wo, wie burst’en wir in die Cloud, wie halten wir Latenz und Kosten im Griff – und hältst die Architektur portabel genug für einen späteren Cloud-Only-Schritt.
  • Du verantwortest Kapazitätsplanung und Hosting-Kosten und machst Kosten zu einem gezielt steuerbaren Hebel.
  • Du führst und entwickelst unser derzeit 4-köpfiges Hosting-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, verantwortest Performance und prägst die technische Standards- und Ownership-Kultur.
  • Du machst AI zum festen Bestandteil unserer Operations: Diagnose, Automatisierung, Monitoring und Insight.


Dein Profil

  • Fundierter Hintergrund in Infrastructure oder Platform Engineering über On-Premise und Cloud hinweg.
  • Hands-on Tiefe mit Kubernetes in Produktion: Cluster-Lifecycle, Upgrades, Networking, Storage, RBAC, Observability, GitOps-Delivery.
  • Nachweislich starke Führungserfahrung, exzellente Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management.
  • Idealerweise praktische Erfahrung mit Harvester oder vergleichbaren HCI-/Virtualisierungsplattformen (KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack).
  • Erfahrung mit einer echten Migration von Bare Metal / klassischen VMs auf eine k8s-basierte Plattform – inklusive stateful Workloads, Storage-Migration, Cutover und Rollback.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kubernetes Operators (Custom Controllers / CRDs), idealerweise für stateful Systeme wie Search, Datenbanken oder Streaming.
  • Solides Verständnis von Auto-Scaling-Primitiven (HPA, VPA, Cluster Autoscaler, KEDA) und deren Zusammenspiel mit Kapazitätsplanung.
  • Erfahrung mit On-Prem-Hybrid-Architekturen und der Verantwortung für Reliability, Kapazität und Kosten produktiver Systeme.
  • Hands-on Fluency im Einsatz von AI-Tools im operativen Betrieb.
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; Deutsch von Vorteil.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Impact from day one: Deine Arbeit wirkt direkt auf die Umsätze führender eCommerce-Marken in Europa.
  • Führungsrolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Du führst ein eingespieltes Team und gestaltest unsere Plattform in einer entscheidenden Phase unserer Transformation.
  • Moderner Tech-Stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, Auto-Scaling und ein spannender Weg in Richtung Cloud – mit Raum, Dinge neu und richtig zu bauen.

Du bekommst echte Ownership für zugewiesene Produkt-Streams innerhalb unseres B2B-Portfolios. Du navigierst eigenständig durch ein komplexes Stakeholder-Umfeld. Wir erwarten, dass Du Konflikte direkt löst - nicht eskalierst.

  • Du schreibst klare Specs und Tickets, die ohne Nacharbeit ins Development gehen.
  • Du erkennst, wann ein Prozess oder Sprint-Ritual der schnellen Problemlösung im Weg steht, und brichst es pragmatisch in Absprache mit dem Team auf.

title: Software Release & Configuration Manager (m/f/d)
description:
As a Software Release & Configuration Manager (m/f/d), you will be the central point of control for all software delivery activities across multiple software engineering teams. You will oversee feature development progress, manage release schedules, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software for our advanced drone systems.

You will coordinate daily operations, manage tickets and workflow, and act as the decision-maker when priorities conflict, always keeping delivery commitments on track. This roles requires a mix of technical understanding of software architecture, organizational skills and assertive leadership. In a highly skilled team, you will play a key role in pushing the boundaries of modern software solutions for our high-tech drones.

You will work closely with stakeholders from our software teams as well as adjacent departments (such as hardware development and product management). By ensuring timely software deliveries, you will support Quantum-Systems in its mission to become the leader for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV). 

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the release process for all software components, including embedded firmware, ground control software, and AI mission packages.

  • Monitor and track development progress across multiple teams, ensuring alignment with release timelines.

  • Manage configuration and version control for all software artifacts and environments.

  • Lead daily stand-ups and coordination meetings, driving clarity and accountability.

  • Maintain and prioritize the backlog, ensuring tickets are properly managed and resolved.

  • Act as the decision authority when trade-offs are needed to meet delivery deadlines.

  • Define and enforce release policies, including branching strategies, quality gates, and approval workflows.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (engineering, QA, product management) to ensure smooth and predictable releases.

  • Continuously improve release processes, introducing automation and best practices where possible.




What you bring to the team:

  • A successfully completed degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a comparable qualification.

  • 5+ years of experience in software release management, configuration management, or similar roles.

  • Proven experience in managing projects and leading teams.

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (GitLab/GitHub), and branching strategies.

  • Experience with ticketing systems (e.g., Jira) and agile methodologies.

  • Familiarity with embedded software development and multi-component systems.

  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to make tough decisions under pressure.

  • Experience with DO-178C is advantageous.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • Proactive, organized and a team player mindset

  • Ability to balance multiple assignments


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

title: Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking (m/f/d)
description:
Join Quantum-Systems and bring autonomous trucks into real-world operations. As Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking, you are the technical owner of the entire program and you identify yourself with the success of this product: you set the technical direction, shape the system architecture, and turn customer needs into an integrated, executable delivery plan. You orchestrate the complete system, from base vehicle and autonomy hardware to the autonomy software stack and full system integration, and you drive it to maturity, primarily for defense logistics applications in regulated environments.

You work in an extremely tight partnership with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how we achieve it technically and by when we deliver. Together you balance product ambition against engineering reality, make trade-offs consciously, and keep one integrated plan that the whole organization can execute against.

This is a senior individual contributor role with maximum leverage: you align workstream leads, domain experts, truck OEM partners, and central functions into one integrated product and one executable delivery plan. You are the technical counterpart to Product, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, external stakeholder (OEMs), and the credible engineering voice towards senior leadership.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the Technical Program

    • Own the end-to-end technical orchestration of our autonomous trucking program with strong focus on integration, execution readiness, and delivery reliability.

    • Define and maintain the integrated technical roadmap: milestones, dependencies, and critical path from development through deployment, performance, and certification goals.

    • Identify integration gaps, decision bottlenecks, and execution risks early; escalate with judgement and propose solution options

    • Ensure technical trade-offs are transparent and made consciously across product, engineering, and operations.

  • Drive System Integration to series industrialisation and production

    • Align technical integration and ensure convergence across base vehicle, autonomy hardware stack, autonomy software stack (modular and End2End planner approaches), verification and validation, ground operations and test, and systems engineering including safety and security.

    • Drive technical maturity from subsystem status to validated system behavior; ensure interfaces are clear, owned, and validated between the teams

    • Push for integration planning with the right cadence of reviews, demos, test evidence, and decision points.

  • Partner with Product Management

    • Work in an extremely tight loop with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how and by when we deliver it in lockstep alignment with engineering management.

    • Translate product intent into technical execution clarity; challenge unclear scope, unclear priorities, or missing system implications early.

    • Shape realistic sequencing between product ambition and engineering capacity.

    • Build trusted, eye-level working relationships with truck OEM engineering teams and manage the joint technical interfaces, handovers, and delivery commitments.

    • Act as the strong technical counterpart to Sales, Supply Chain, and Operations: connect program needs with sourcing timelines, service concepts, and operational readiness.

    • Create alignment across internal engineering teams and domains on priorities, interfaces, and expected delivery contributions.

  • Be a Senior Technical Leader

    • Operate with high autonomy and high judgement; represent the technical program in reviews up to C-level.

    • Be a calm, credible, and sharp voice in high-stakes discussions, internally and towards partners and customers.

    • Raise the bar on accountability, collaboration, and delivery discipline across workstream leads and domain experts, without creating unnecessary process overhead.




What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in a relevant field (e.g. Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or comparable).

  • 10+ years of experience in autonomous driving or field robotics, ideally with several years in autonomous trucking.

  • Outstanding technical depth across the full autonomous driving system: autonomy software (perception, planning, control, end to end planner architectures), autonomy hardware (compute, sensors, user interfaces), base vehicle hardware architecture, and system integration.

  • Proven experience delivering complex systems in regulated environments; defense background is a strong plus but not mandatory.

  • Outstanding technical project and program management skills: roadmapping, critical path management, risk management, and delivery steering of multi-team workstreams.

  • Track record of working with vehicle OEMs, ideally truck OEMs, on joint development and integration programs.

  • Outstanding communication skills: condensate complex technical discussions into actionable items per team.

  • Systems thinker: you think in milestones and integration maturity, not in isolated component optimization.

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

  • High ownership, pragmatic, hands-on mindset; willingness to travel to OEM, partner, and test sites.

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

title: Working Student - Logistics (f/m/d)
description:
At Instagrid, you are part of the clean-tech revolution by bringing pure energy into your region, helping professional workers transitioning away from combustion generators and making it possible for them to experience a safe, efficient, clean and silent energy solution.

Your Mission

Instagrid ships hardware — globally, at volume, to customers who expect their orders to arrive on time and on spec. As a Working Student in Logistics, you keep that promise. You are the operational backbone of our internal shipping area: handling incoming and outgoing goods, managing documentation, coordinating carriers, and serving as the link between physical goods movement and the Sales and Customer Management teams who need accurate, real-time information to do their jobs.

This is an on-site role in Ludwigsburg. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Operations team — expect to spend real time on the warehouse floor, not behind a screen.

Your Impact

  • Incoming goods: Receive and verify deliveries against purchase orders, create item receipts in NetSuite, and flag discrepancies without delay

  • Outgoing goods: Pick, pack, and dispatch finished goods and spare parts accurately and on time, in line with customer orders and internal shipping requests

  • Carrier management: Select the right carrier and service level for each shipment, book collections, and keep carrier accounts and documentation up to date

  • Order fulfilment: Coordinate daily with our external warehouse partner to ensure all market demands are serviced without gaps

  • Returns processing: Unpack, inspect, and document customer returns; hand over items to quality or repair workflows with full traceability

  • Shipping documentation: Produce commercial invoices, packing lists, and delivery notes accurately and in a timely manner

  • Tracking and visibility: Keep Sales and Customer Management proactively informed on shipment status, resolve carrier exceptions early, and escalate delays before they reach the customer

  • Warehouse housekeeping: Maintain clean, labelled, and accurately stocked storage locations in line with our ERP records

  • Currently enrolled in logistics, supply chain management, business administration, or a related degree program

  • Reliable and committed to showing up — this is a fixed on-site role that requires consistent coordination around your university timetable

  • Precise and structured in everything you do: in logistics, a documentation error is not a minor mistake — it has consequences, and you know that

  • A proactive communicator who raises issues and shares updates without needing to be prompted

  • Confident using digital tools: ERP systems, carrier portals, and spreadsheets are part of your daily workflow

  • Fluent in German and English — both are essential for working with carriers, partners, and customers

Your Benefits

  • Real responsibility from day one — not busywork, but genuine ownership of live shipping operations

  • End-to-end exposure: from goods receipt and carrier selection through order fulfilment to returns and customer visibility

  • A lean, hands-on team that gives direct feedback and expects you to speak up when something isn't right

  • An inside view of what it takes to scale a hardware company — across operations, supply chain, and beyond

  • Flexible working hours coordinated around your university schedule

  • Generous holiday entitlement plus additional special leave days, on a pro-rata basis

This is Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact. Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning.

At Instagrid, we are deeply committed to equal employment opportunities as we believe in the power of diverse teams. We do not just accept diversity but actively search for the best talent regardless of gender, ethnic origin, age, religion, sexual orientation or place of origin. Working as a team, we treat each other with respect and value each other’s opinions to achieve our common goals.

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Data Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Du möchtest nicht nur Daten verarbeiten, sondern eine moderne Datenplattform entwickeln, die Analysen, Reporting und datengetriebene Entscheidungen im gesamten Unternehmen ermöglicht? 

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. 

Unser Kunde, ein dynamisch wachsende E-Commerce Service Agentur in Berlin, zählt zu den erfolgreichsten Amazon-Händlern Deutschlands und vertreibt tausende Produkte 

Für den weiteren Ausbau der Data & Analytics Landschaft wird eine Persönlichkeit gesucht, die moderne Datenarchitekturen entwickelt und den Weg zu einer datengetriebenen Organisation aktiv mitgestaltet 

Deine Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.  

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr.  

  • Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen.  

  • Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet.  

  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg.  

  • Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro.  

  • Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander.  

  • Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung.  

  • Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits. 

Deine Aufgaben

Als Data Engineer entwickelst und betreibst du moderne Datenplattformen in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric und sorgst dafür, dass hochwertige Daten zuverlässig für Analysen, Reporting und Machine-Learning-Anwendungen bereitstehen. 

  • Data Engineering: Konzeption, Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung moderner Datenpipelines in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Datenqualität: Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität, Vollständigkeit und Reproduzierbarkeit sowie Implementierung effizienter inkrementeller Datenladeprozesse.  

  • Datenintegration: Entwicklung und Pflege effizienter ETL-/ELT-Prozesse sowie API-basierter Datenintegrationen.  

  • Plattformbetrieb: Entwicklung robuster Monitoring-, Logging- und Fehlerbehandlungskonzepte sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance, Kosten und Datenworkflows.  

  • Data Architecture: Mitarbeit am Aufbau einer skalierbaren Datenarchitektur inklusive Test-, Staging- und Produktionsumgebungen sowie moderner Technologien wie CI/CD, Fabric Pipelines, dbt oder Airflow.  

  • Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Data & Analytics und den Data Analysts zur Bereitstellung hochwertiger Daten für Power BI Dashboards und Machine-Learning-Modelle. 

Dein Profil als Data Engineer

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenpipelines oder Datenplattformen – idealerweise auf Senior-Level, motivierte Mid-Level-Profile sind ebenfalls willkommen.  

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Azure Data Services, insbesondere Data Factory und/oder Azure Synapse; idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric.  

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL und Python, insbesondere im Bereich ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Automatisierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung, idealerweise mit Bronze-, Silver- und Gold-Layer-Architekturen.  

  • Kenntnisse im Datenqualitätsmanagement sowie in Monitoring, Logging und Performance-Optimierung.  

  • Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Umsetzung technischer Projekte sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.  

  • Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Umfeld.  

  • Fließende Deutsch- oder Englischkenntnisse. Bei geringeren Deutschkenntnissen (ab B1) werden dafür sehr gute Englischkenntnisse vorausgesetzt.  

Nice-to-haves – jedes zusätzliche Know-how ist ein Pluspunkt:

  • Erfahrung mit inkrementellen Ladeprozessen und Delta-Verarbeitung.  

  • Erfahrung in der Datenintegration für Power BI sowie im Umgang mit semantischen Modellen.  

  • Kenntnisse im E-Commerce- oder Amazon-Umfeld.  

  • Erfahrung mit API-basierten Datenintegrationen.  

  • Kenntnisse in CI/CD, z. B. mit GitHub Actions oder Azure DevOps.  

  • Interesse an Machine Learning und dem Aufbau datengetriebener Organisationen.  

  • Erfahrung mit Openbridge. 

Die Rolle als Data Engineer klingt genau nach dir? Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und wir geben dir in einem kurzen Telefonat alle weiteren Infos zu Stelle und Unternehmen.

Aufgaben

Gleichzeitig hast du einen zweiten Auftrag, der genauso wichtig ist: Du führst so viele Projekte wie möglich über unsere Standardprozesse, damit Klub als Plattform skalierbar bleibt und nicht in Sonderlösungen erstickt. Diese Doppelrolle – nach außen verbindlich, nach innen konsequent – ist der Kern des Jobs.

Wir freuen uns auf Mitunternehmer*innen, um gemeinsam mit dem jungen Team und Geschäftsführer Sebastian die Geschicke von Klub44 zu leiten.

Projektsteuerung

  • Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung unserer laufenden Kooperationsprojekte – von Kick-off bis Abschluss.

  • Frühzeitiges Erkennen von Risiken und aktives Gegensteuern, statt Überraschungen am Projektende.
  • Sicherstellen, dass zugesagte Ziele (z. B. teilnehmende Standorte, aktive Jugendliche, Angebots-Uploads) tatsächlich erreicht werden.

Account Management & Partnerbetreuung

  • Du bist die verlässliche Ansprechperson für unsere Projektpartner in Kommunen, Schulen und Stiftungen – die Stimme von Klub im Alltag.
  • Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen: Bestehende Kooperationen erfolgreich umsetzen, verlängern und ausbauen.
  • Erwartungsmanagement mit Verwaltungen, Schulleitungen und Förderpartnern: klar sagen, was geht, und was nicht.
  • Übersetzungsarbeit zwischen kommunaler Logik und Startup-Tempo – in beide Richtungen.

Skalierbarkeit & Standardprozesse

  • Onboarding von Kommunen, Schulen und Jugendeinrichtungen entlang unserer Standardprozesse – wiederholbar statt jedes Mal neu.
  • Weiterentwicklung dieser Prozesse: Playbooks, Templates, Checklisten, Automatisierungen.
  • Erkennen, wann eine Partneranfrage ein Sonderfall ist – und wann sie in ein neues Standardangebot gehört.
  • Bewusstes Nein zu Individuallösungen, die uns langfristig teuer werden.

Zahlen, Reporting & Wirkung

  • Aufbereitung von Projektständen und Wirkungsdaten für Zuwendungsgeber und Stiftungen – die Verantwortung für Verwendungsnachweise und Reportings liegt bei der Geschäftsführung, du lieferst die Grundlage.
  • Ableiten konkreter Maßnahmen aus den Zahlen, nicht nur Dokumentation.

Zusammenarbeit im Team

  • Enge Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing & Community und Produktentwicklung.
  • Rückkopplung von Partner-Feedback ins Produkt: Was brauchen Kommunen und Standorte wirklich?
  • Steuerung externer Partner und Dienstleister im Projektkontext.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und bringst Projekte nachweislich zum Abschluss – idealerweise mit Partnern aus Verwaltung, Bildung, Stiftungen oder NGOs. Arbeitserfahrung in einem Startup ist ein guter Bonus.

  • Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, nicht in Einzelfällen – und hast Freude daran, Wiederholbares zu bauen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und verbindlich: Zusagen, Fristen und Follow-ups sitzen bei dir.
  • Du bist "hands on" und sicher im Umgang mit agilen Methoden und Projektmanagement-Tools.
  • Du arbeitest datenbasiert und bist sicher im Nachhalten von Kennzahlen.
  • Dich motivieren unternehmerische Herausforderungen und du möchtest persönlich dazu beitragen, Jugendliche bei einer chancengerechten Entfaltung ihrer Potenziale zu fördern.
  • Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse.

The Commercial Systems and Intelligence squad is a newly formed team within SumUp's Acquisition Mission under the Run & Grow tribe.
